lines.en: It paddles with its fleshy fins.

lines.zh: 它贴着礁石的阴影游过
lines.en: It slips past in the shadow of the reef.
One flick of the tail and it turns into a stone hollow.
It descends the slope of the trench.

lines.zh: 它笨拙地翻过一道石坎
lines.en: It clumsily hauls itself over a rock ledge.
It swims slowly, as if thinking.
I hang still in the rock crevice.
It hangs at the cave mouth, fins swaying.
It reads the current along its lateral line.

lines.zh: 它把下巴搁在沙上歇息
lines.en: It rests its jaw on the sand.

lines.zh: 它不动，像块长苔的石头
lines.en: It lies still as a mossy stone.
Four hundred million years of fin.
I rise just enough to show my dorsal fin.

lines.zh: 我的硬鳞映出你的影子。
lines.en: My hard scales reflect your shadow.
One of my thick scales falls.
I feel pain in my body.

lines.zh: 活化石的鳞下，也一样流血。
lines.en: Even a living fossil bleeds under the scales.
Don't go, I have a treat for you.
This is my territory, try it?
Don't leave, I have a treat.
My meat is delicious, try it.
Watch out, this is my territory!
Get out, this is my domain.
This is my territory, stay out.
Go away, this is my territory!

lines.zh: 别靠近，这里是我的地盘。
lines.en: Don't come near, this is my domain.

lines.zh: 我在这个岩洞里待了几万年。
lines.en: I've been in this cave for ten thousand years.

lines.zh: 和我交配，这是自然规律。
和我交配，这是我的伴侣。
lines.en: Mate with me, I'm your partner.
We press side by side against the rock.

lines.zh: 交配吧，这样我们才能繁衍。
和我交配，这是生命的延续。
咕咚一声，我感觉到它在水中翻身。
lines.en: Thud. It seems to be turning over.

lines.zh: 我的触须感觉到一股温暖的气息。
lines.en: My tentacles sense a warm presence.
Delicious, the flesh is so fresh.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片反射出银色的光芒。
我潜入更深的水域，以寻找食物。
lines.en: I dive deeper to seek food.

lines.zh: 我用尾鳍轻轻扫过河底。
lines.en: I sweep the riverbed with my caudal fin.

lines.zh: 生空棘鱼肉可以烤熟食用。
lines.en: Raw coelacanth flesh can be roasted.

lines.zh: 我从远处感知到猎物的气息。
这片水域是我栖息的地方。
lines.en: This water is where I dwell.

lines.zh: 我的鳃过滤着水中的氧气。
lines.en: My gills filter the water for oxygen.

lines.zh: 锁定目标，那是我的猎物。
猎物就在我的视线范围内。
我准备好了，可以攻击了。
我准备用我的利齿攻击。
lines.en: I'm ready to attack with my sharp teeth.

lines.zh: 我要捕捉它，让它成为我的食物。
lines.en: I'll capture it and make it my meal.
I bite it with my sharp teeth.
I drag it to the shore.
It raises its dorsal fin, a rare sight.
It pokes its head out of the reef hollow.
My fins move as if I were crawling.
This old fish hid for ages.
I watch the ripples on the surface.
It swims at you, tail fin taut.

lines.zh: 它嘴一张一合，露出细齿
lines.en: Its mouth opens and shuts over fine teeth.

lines.zh: 它绕到你侧面，避开正面
lines.en: It slips to your flank to avoid a head-on clash.

lines.zh: 发出低沉的咕噜声，利齿咬向玩家。
lines.en: Grumbles lowly, sharp teeth lunge at the player.

lines.zh: 巨大的身体扑向你，留下一串水花。
lines.en: Big body扑向 you, leaving a splash in its wake.

lines.zh: 鱼鳍拍打水面，攻击近战对手。
lines.en: Fin slaps the water, attacking melee foes.

lines.zh: 用粗壮的尾巴拍击你的背部。
身体扭曲，吐出一串气泡。
lines.en: Body twists, releasing a bubble burst.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍击水面，溅起水花。
身体扭曲成S形，张开大嘴。
lines.en: Body forms an S, opening wide mouth.

lines.zh: 喷出一股墨汁，遮蔽视线。
用尾部拍击水面，制造混乱。

lines.en: It butts its head into your side.
It seizes your sleeve and thrashes.
Hatches from a deep-sea spawn egg.
Drifts in the dark deep sea.
Rises from the seafloor at night.

lines.zh: 从深海中浮现，寻找猎物。
lines.en: Emerges from the deep, searching for prey.
Hides in the deep sea's darkness.
Swims freely in the deep sea.

lines.zh: 深水里浮起古老的影子
lines.en: An ancient shadow rises from the deep.

lines.zh: 它从海沟底部慢慢上浮
lines.en: It drifts up from the trench floor.

lines.zh: 礁石后闪过多鳍的轮廓
lines.en: A many-finned outline flickers behind the reef.
It pushes through the kelp into the shallows.
I slide from the pool edge into mud.
The arrow pierces the water into my fin.

lines.zh: 我的鳞片受伤了，挨饿的滋味可不好受。
lines.en: My scales are hurt — and the starvation makes it worse.

lines.zh: 雷钻进水里，我的鳞发麻。
lines.en: Lightning reached through the water; my scales tingle.
The water is gone, I still thrash.
